SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
  AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.0018

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN doctype = 'Unified School District' AND county = 'Orange' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN doctype = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE statustype = 'Merged'

SELECT s.mailstreet, s.school
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE sat.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.avgscrmath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

WITH locally_funded AS (
  SELECT s.school,
         s.doctype,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_diff
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT school, doctype
FROM locally_funded
WHERE enrollment_diff > (SELECT AVG(enrollment_diff) FROM locally_funded)

SELECT ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"::numeric, 6) AS "K-12 Eligible FRPM Rate"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s."soc" = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS max_free_meal_rate_ages_5_17
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN frpm f
    ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.numge1500 * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.numtsttakr, 0) > 0.3

SELECT "School Name",
       "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) * 100 AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9'

SELECT s.ncesschool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f.cdscode IN ('01751010130583', '01612910137588', '01611760134270')
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = (
      SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
      FROM frpm f2
      WHERE f2.cdscode IN ('01751010130583', '01612910137588', '01611760134270')
  )

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT admemail1, admemail2, admemail3
  FROM schools
  WHERE soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
    AND city = 'San Bernardino'
    AND county = 'San Bernardino'
    AND doctype = 'Unified School District'
    AND opendate BETWEEN DATE '2009-01-01' AND DATE '2010-12-31'
)
SELECT admemail1 AS email FROM filtered WHERE admemail1 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT admemail2 AS email FROM filtered WHERE admemail2 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT admemail3 AS email FROM filtered WHERE admemail3 IS NOT NULL

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
       f."District Code"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.charternum = '0756'
  AND s.mailcity = 'San Diego'

WITH hs AS (
  SELECT
    s.school,
    s.gsserved,
    split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1) AS low_grade,
    split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 2) AS high_grade
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.ncesdist = '0613360'
    AND s.statustype = 'Active'
    AND (sat.numtsttakr IS NULL OR sat.numtsttakr = 0)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    school,
    gsserved,
    CASE
      WHEN low_grade = 'PS' THEN -1
      WHEN low_grade = 'K' THEN 0
      WHEN low_grade ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN low_grade::int
      ELSE NULL
    END AS start_rank
  FROM hs
  WHERE high_grade = '12'
)
SELECT school, gsserved
FROM ranked
WHERE start_rank IS NOT NULL
  AND start_rank = (SELECT MIN(start_rank) FROM ranked WHERE start_rank IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY school

WITH sb_schools AS (
    SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet, sat.avgscrread
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.doctype = 'State Board of Education'
      AND sat.rtype = 'S'
      AND sat.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT school, mailstreet
FROM sb_schools
WHERE avgscrread = (SELECT MAX(avgscrread) FROM sb_schools)

SELECT sat.avgscrmath, sat.numtsttakr
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS sc
  ON sc.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.cds = LPAD('1611190130609', 14, '0')
  AND sc.fundingtype = 'Directly funded'

SELECT DISTINCT s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = LPAD('1611920113902', 14, '0')
  AND s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'

SELECT s.school, s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND TRIM(split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1)) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND CAST(TRIM(split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1)) AS INTEGER) > 9
GROUP BY s.cdscode, s.school, s.city
ORDER BY s.school

SELECT s.school, s.phone
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.doc = '98'
  AND sat.numge1500 = (
      SELECT MAX(sat2.numge1500)
      FROM satscores sat2
      JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.cdscode
      WHERE s2.doc = '98'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.mailcity = 'San Francisco'
  AND sc.doctype IN (
        'Unified School District',
        'High School District',
        'Elementary School District',
        'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND (s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite) >= 1500

SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_ahead
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
  AND rtype = 'S'
  AND numtsttakr > (
      SELECT numtsttakr
      FROM satscores
      WHERE cds = LPAD('7618040730051', 14, '0')
  )

SELECT school, eilname
FROM schools
WHERE cdscode = '1612590136051'

SELECT s.low_grade
FROM (
    SELECT split_part(gsserved, '-', 1) AS low_grade
    FROM schools
    WHERE ncesdist = '0632640'
      AND gsserved IS NOT NULL
) s
WHERE s.low_grade ~ '^(K|[0-9]+)$'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.low_grade = 'K' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(s.low_grade AS INTEGER) END
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(
         COALESCE(SUM(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"), 0)::numeric
         / COUNT(s.cdscode),
         2) AS avg_frpm_count_ages_5_17
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
       ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
      AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.soctype ILIKE '%Youth Authority%'

WITH sb_schools AS (
    SELECT s.school,
           s.admemail1,
           sat.numge1500
    FROM satscores sat
    JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.doctype = 'State Board of Education'
      AND sat.rtype = 'S'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT school,
           admemail1,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY numge1500 DESC NULLS LAST) AS rk
    FROM sb_schools
)
SELECT school, admemail1
FROM ranked
WHERE rk = 1

WITH middle AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f."School Type", f."School Name", s.latitude
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE f."School Type" ILIKE '%Middle%'
       OR f."School Name" ILIKE '%Middle%'
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", latitude
FROM middle
WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM middle)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM schools sc
LEFT JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND sc.opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01'
  AND sc.opendate <  DATE '2008-01-01'
  AND (sc.doctype LIKE '%School District%'
       OR sc.doctype = 'County Office of Education (COE)')

WITH sch AS (
    SELECT cdscode, district, county, doctype, admfname1 AS fname
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
    UNION
    SELECT cdscode, district, county, doctype, admfname2 AS fname
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
    UNION
    SELECT cdscode, district, county, doctype, admfname3 AS fname
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT fname, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS n
    FROM sch
    WHERE fname IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY fname
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT fname
    FROM name_counts
    ORDER BY n DESC, fname ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
public_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
),
district_name_counts AS (
    SELECT district, fname, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS n
    FROM sch
    WHERE doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
      AND fname IN (SELECT fname FROM top_names)
    GROUP BY district, fname
)
SELECT d.district AS "District Name",
       t.fname AS "First Name",
       COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS "Number of Schools"
FROM public_districts d
CROSS JOIN top_names t
LEFT JOIN district_name_counts c
       ON c.district = d.district
      AND c.fname = t.fname
ORDER BY d.district, t.fname

SELECT
    s.fundingtype AS funding_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND(AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") * 100, 2) AS avg_pct_frpm_eligible,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cds,
           avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite AS combined_sat
    FROM satscores
    WHERE avgscrread IS NOT NULL
      AND avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
      AND avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
) sat
    ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype

WITH closed_sat AS (
    SELECT s.school,
           s.district,
           s.county,
           sat.avgscrwrite
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.statustype = 'Closed'
      AND sat.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT school,
           district,
           county,
           avgscrwrite,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avgscrwrite DESC) AS rnk
    FROM closed_sat
)
SELECT school,
       district,
       county,
       avgscrwrite
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 2

WITH sp AS (
    SELECT
        f.cdscode,
        f."School Name" AS school_name,
        f."Low Grade" AS low_grade,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enroll,
        CASE
            WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN -1
            WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
            ELSE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS integer)
        END AS grade_rank
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
      AND s.doctype = 'State Special Schools'
      AND (f."Low Grade" IN ('P', 'K') OR f."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$')
)
SELECT
    sp.school_name,
    sp.low_grade,
    sp.enroll AS enrollment_k12,
    COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM sp
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = sp.cdscode
ORDER BY sp.grade_rank DESC, sp.enroll DESC NULLS LAST, sp.school_name ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.cdscode) AS school_count
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s
  ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS integer) <= 8
  AND s.school IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.school) <> ''
  AND COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

SELECT
    f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment,
    SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm_count
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.doctype = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY f."Charter Funding Type"
ORDER BY CASE f."Charter Funding Type"
            WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
         END

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.eilname = 'High School'
  AND COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric / 12 AS avg_schools_opened_per_month
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'San Diego'
  AND opendate BETWEEN DATE '1980-01-01' AND DATE '1980-12-31'
  AND doctype IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District')

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN s.virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*),
         1
       ) AS virtual_percentage
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE sat.avgscrmath > 400

SELECT
    s.school AS school_name,
    s.county,
    s.district,
    s.city,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    sat.numtsttakr,
    sat.avgscrread,
    sat.avgscrmath,
    sat.avgscrwrite,
    sat.numge1500
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
    ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = LPAD('1612590137943', 14, '0')

SELECT
    s.school AS school_name,
    s.phone AS phone_number,
    s.website AS website,
    sat.avgscrread AS avg_sat_reading,
    sat.avgscrmath AS avg_sat_math,
    sat.avgscrwrite AS avg_sat_writing,
    s.charter AS charter_school,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND((f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pct_frpm_eligible,
    m.top_math AS highest_avg_sat_math,
    m.top_math - sat.avgscrmath AS math_gap_from_highest
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
    ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(sa.avgscrmath) AS top_math
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc
        ON sc.cdscode = sa.cds
    WHERE sc.statustype = 'Active'
      AND sa.numtsttakr >= 10
) m
WHERE s.cdscode = '7618040113118'

SELECT
  f."County Name" AS county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::numeric, 2)), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(ROUND((f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::numeric, 2)), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1) AS charter_school_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0) AS non_charter_school_count,
  ROUND(AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite)::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM frpm f
LEFT JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."County Name" = (
        SELECT f2."County Name"
        FROM frpm f2
        WHERE f2.cdscode = '1612590125716'
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
GROUP BY f."County Name"

WITH target_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT county
    FROM schools
    WHERE cdscode = LPAD('1100170109835', 14, '0')
    UNION
    SELECT 'Santa Barbara'
)
SELECT t.county,
       COUNT(s.cdscode) AS num_virtual_schools
FROM target_counties t
LEFT JOIN schools s
       ON s.county = t.county
      AND s.virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY t.county
ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC, t.county ASC

WITH virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT s.cdscode, s.county, s.school
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
  SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM virtual_schools
  GROUP BY county
),
ranked_counties AS (
  SELECT county, cnt,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rk
  FROM county_counts
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT county, cnt
  FROM ranked_counties
  WHERE rk <= 5
),
school_scores AS (
  SELECT vs.county, vs.school, sat.avgscrread
  FROM virtual_schools vs
  JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = vs.cdscode
  WHERE sat.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
),
best_schools AS (
  SELECT county, school
  FROM (
    SELECT county, school,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avgscrread DESC) AS rk
    FROM school_scores
  ) t
  WHERE rk = 1
)
SELECT tc.county AS county_name,
       tc.cnt AS exclusively_virtual_school_count,
       COALESCE(b.school, 'None') AS school_name
FROM top_counties tc
LEFT JOIN best_schools b ON b.county = tc.county
ORDER BY tc.cnt DESC, tc.county, b.school

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.cdscode,
        s.school,
        s.charter,
        s.gsserved,
        f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_rate
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.county = 'Alameda'
      AND s.gsserved LIKE '%-12'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT b.*, MAX(b.free_rate) OVER () AS max_rate
    FROM base b
    WHERE b.free_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    r.school AS school_name,
    ROUND(r.free_rate::numeric, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN r.charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN r.charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    r.gsserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN sat.avgscrread IS NULL OR sat.avgscrmath IS NULL OR sat.avgscrwrite IS NULL
            THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = r.cdscode
WHERE r.free_rate = r.max_rate

SELECT DISTINCT s.school, s.street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.school IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND f."High Grade" IN ('K', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8')

SELECT s.school, s.street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND f."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
ORDER BY f.cdscode

WITH target AS (
    SELECT county
    FROM schools
    WHERE cdscode = LPAD('1611430131177', 14, '0')
)
SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.county = (SELECT county FROM target)
ORDER BY sat.numge1500 DESC NULLS LAST, sat.cds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT f."County Name" AS county,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.cdscode) AS num_schools
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) > 0.1
  AND s.numge1500 >= 1
GROUP BY f."County Name"
ORDER BY num_schools DESC, county ASC

SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.numtsttakr >= 700
ORDER BY (sat.numge1500::numeric / sat.numtsttakr) ASC, sat.cds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE bordercolor = 'borderless'
  AND (cardkingdomid IS NULL OR cardkingdomfoilid IS NULL)

SELECT s.city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS magnet_provision2_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.city IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.city

SELECT DISTINCT text
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Benalish Knight'

WITH ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM rulings
    GROUP BY uuid
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS mx
    FROM ruling_counts
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.artist, c.ispromo
FROM cards c
JOIN ruling_counts r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE r.cnt = (SELECT mx FROM max_count)

WITH p2_magnet_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.cdscode, s.county
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.magnet = 1
      AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
)
SELECT p.county AS county_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(sat.numtsttakr), 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM p2_magnet_schools p
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = p.cdscode
GROUP BY p.county

SELECT s.school,
       s.street,
       s.city,
       s.state,
       s.zip
FROM schools s
WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM frpm f
        WHERE f.cdscode = s.cdscode
          AND f."School Type" IN ('High Schools (Public)',
                                  'Continuation High Schools (Public)',
                                  'High Schools in 1 School District (Public)')
          AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
      )
ORDER BY s.school

SELECT ROUND(
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*),
         2
       ) AS percentage
FROM set_translations

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE dueldeck = 'a'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS banned_white_bordered_printings
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.bordercolor = 'white'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'

WITH base AS (

         s.opendate,

         f."Enrollment (K-12)"      AS enroll,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)"      AS frpm_cnt,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS frpm_share,
         sat.avgscrread,
         sat.avgscrmath,
         sat.avgscrwrite,
         sat.numtsttakr,
         sat.numge1500
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm f       ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds  = s.cdscode

eligible AS (
  SELECT *

    AND enroll > 100
    AND frpm_cnt IS NOT NULL
    AND frpm_share IS NOT NULL

labeled AS (

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'the CDS code from my notes', *

  WHERE cdscode = '4615150435602'
)

       county,
       city,
       mailstreet,
       mailcity,
       mailstate,
       mailzip,
       website,

       frpm_cnt AS frpm_eligible_count,
       frpm_share AS frpm_share,
       (avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite) AS avg_total_sat,
       numge1500 * 100.0 / NULLIF(numtsttakr, 0) AS pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,

    FROM match m
    JOIN country c ON c.id = m.country_id
    WHERE c.name = 'England'
      AND (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
  )

WITH fast_home_wins AS (
  SELECT m.id AS match_id,
         m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
  FROM match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
    AND (
      SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
      FROM team_attributes ta
      WHERE ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
        AND ta.date::timestamp <= m.date::timestamp
      ORDER BY ta.date::timestamp DESC, ta.id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) = 'Fast'
),
win_counts AS (
  SELECT team_api_id,
         COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM fast_home_wins
  GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name,
       t.team_short_name,
       wc.wins
FROM win_counts wc
JOIN team t
  ON t.team_api_id = wc.team_api_id
WHERE wc.wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM win_counts)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS avg_total_home_goals
FROM (
  SELECT home_player_3, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
  FROM match
  WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY home_player_3
) AS player_totals

WITH heavy_players AS (
  SELECT m.country_id, pl.weight
  FROM match m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4),
      (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6), (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8),
      (m.home_player_9), (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
      (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3), (m.away_player_4),
      (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6), (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8),
      (m.away_player_9), (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
  ) AS hp(player_api_id)
  JOIN player pl ON pl.player_api_id = hp.player_api_id
  WHERE pl.weight >= 210
),
country_counts AS (
  SELECT c.name AS country_name, COUNT(*) AS heavy_player_count
  FROM heavy_players h
  JOIN country c ON c.id = h.country_id
  GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT country_name, heavy_player_count
FROM country_counts
WHERE heavy_player_count = (SELECT MAX(heavy_player_count) FROM country_counts)
ORDER BY country_name

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id)
         player_api_id,
         volleys
  FROM player_attributes
  ORDER BY player_api_id, date DESC, id DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM latest l
WHERE l.volleys > 70
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM player p
        WHERE p.player_api_id = l.player_api_id
          AND p.height > 180
      )

WITH italy_matches AS (
  SELECT m.season,
         m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
         m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
         m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
         m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
         m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
         m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  FROM match m
  JOIN country c ON m.country_id = c.id
  WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
    AND m.season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
),
lineup AS (
  SELECT season,
         unnest(ARRAY[
           home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
           home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
           home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11,
           away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
           away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
           away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
         ]) AS player_api_id
  FROM italy_matches
),
distinct_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT season, player_api_id
  FROM lineup
  WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT dp.season,
       COUNT(*) AS player_count,
       ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS avg_height
FROM distinct_players dp
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = dp.player_api_id
GROUP BY dp.season
ORDER BY dp.season

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM player_attributes
WHERE date LIKE '2015-01-01%'
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium')

WITH small_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, v.pid
  FROM match m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4),
    (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6), (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8),
    (m.home_player_9), (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
    (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3), (m.away_player_4),
    (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6), (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8),
    (m.away_player_9), (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
  ) AS v(pid)
  JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = v.pid
  WHERE p.weight <= 160
),
country_counts AS (
  SELECT c.name, COUNT(sp.pid) AS cnt
  FROM country c
  LEFT JOIN small_players sp ON sp.country_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM country_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM country_counts)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM player_attributes
WHERE jumping >= 80
  AND CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2007-02-22' AND DATE '2007-08-30'

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    preferred_foot,
    attacking_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY CAST(date AS timestamp) DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM player_attributes
),
current_left AS (
  SELECT attacking_work_rate
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND preferred_foot = 'left'
    AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(attacking_work_rate) <> ''
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attacking_work_rate = 'low')
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  1
) AS percentage
FROM current_left

WITH t AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM team
  WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
),
last_match AS (
  SELECT m.date
  FROM match m
  WHERE m.season = '2012/2013'
    AND (m.home_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM t)
         OR m.away_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM t))
  ORDER BY m.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
FROM team_attributes ta
WHERE ta.team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM t)
  AND ta.date <= (SELECT date FROM last_match)
ORDER BY ta.date DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT x.match_id) AS matches_played
FROM player p
JOIN (
    SELECT m.id AS match_id,
           unnest(ARRAY[
               m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
               m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
               m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
               m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
               m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
               m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
           ]) AS pid
    FROM match m
    WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
) x ON x.pid = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH target_district AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM district
  ORDER BY a11 ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
target_clients AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date
  FROM client c
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM target_district)
),
oldest AS (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM target_clients
  WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM target_clients)
)
SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM district) AS salary_difference
FROM disp d
WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM oldest)

WITH largest_district AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM district
  WHERE a3 = 'south Bohemia'
  ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         2
       ) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM largest_district)

SELECT a.district_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id,
           pa.overall_rating,
           pa.defensive_work_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
               ORDER BY pa.date::timestamp DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM player_attributes pa
    WHERE pa.date::timestamp <= TIMESTAMP '2013-07-12 23:59:59'
),
current_ratings AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating, defensive_work_rate
    FROM latest
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
           ((d.donovan_rating - a.avg_rating) * 100.0 / a.avg_rating)::numeric,
           2
       ) AS pct_higher
FROM (
    SELECT cr.overall_rating AS donovan_rating
    FROM current_ratings cr
    JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = cr.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
) d
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating)::numeric AS avg_rating
    FROM current_ratings
    WHERE defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
) a

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date < '2001-01-01'

WITH loan_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN loan_account la ON t.account_id = la.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN loan_account la ON t.account_id = la.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (be.balance - bs.balance) * 100.0 / bs.balance AS percentage_increase
FROM balance_start bs
CROSS JOIN balance_end be

SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol
FROM account a
JOIN "order" o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND o.amount = 3539

SELECT d.type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND dist.a11 > 8000
  AND dist.a11 <= 9000
GROUP BY d.type

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.district_id,
    ROUND((((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS percentage_change
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
  AND d.a12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.a13 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.a12 <> 0

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
  * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
  AS percentage_growth
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND l.date >= '1996-01-01'
  AND l.date < '1998-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
)
AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')

SELECT di.a2 AS district_name,
       di.a4::bigint AS inhabitants
FROM district di
WHERE di.district_id IN (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE date_trunc('month', a.date) = (SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(date)) FROM account)
)
AND di.a4::bigint = (
    SELECT MAX(d2.a4::bigint)
    FROM district d2
    WHERE d2.district_id IN (
        SELECT a.district_id
        FROM account a
        WHERE date_trunc('month', a.date) = (SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(date)) FROM account)
    )
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM trans t
      WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
        AND t.bank = 'AB'
  )

WITH regional_totals AS (
  SELECT d.a3 AS region,
         SUM(l.amount) AS total
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE l.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
    AND l.date + (l.duration * INTERVAL '1 month') > DATE '1995-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.a3
)
SELECT region, total
FROM regional_totals
WHERE total = (SELECT MAX(total) FROM regional_totals)

WITH top5 AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
acc_counts AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS n_accounts
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM top5)
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
loan_sums AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(l.amount) AS active_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
      AND a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM top5)
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT t.a2,
           ROUND(COALESCE(ls.active_amount, 0)::numeric / ac.n_accounts, 0) AS avg_active_loan
    FROM top5 t
    JOIN acc_counts ac ON ac.district_id = t.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_sums ls ON ls.district_id = t.district_id
)
SELECT a2, avg_active_loan
FROM ratios
WHERE avg_active_loan = (SELECT MAX(avg_active_loan) FROM ratios)

WITH owner_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01'
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT oa.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS cnt
  FROM owner_accounts oa
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = oa.account_id
  GROUP BY oa.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM loan_counts

WITH served_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01'
      AND c.birth_date <  DATE '1990-01-01'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(di.a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_of_district_avg_salaries,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM district di
JOIN served_districts s ON s.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(di.a3)) = 'east bohemia'

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN district dc ON dc.district_id = c.district_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND dc.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp d2
      JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d2.disp_id
      WHERE d2.account_id = d.account_id
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(di.a11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM district di
JOIN qualifying_districts q ON q.district_id = di.district_id

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_payments,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
      AND t.k_symbol <> ''
      AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO'
  ) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans t
WHERE t.amount > 4000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id
      AND c.gender = 'M'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  )

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0),
         2) AS sipo_percentage
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND t.k_symbol <> ''

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d   ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp di      ON di.account_id = a.account_id
                     AND di.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card c       ON c.disp_id = di.disp_id
                     AND c.type = 'gold'
    WHERE CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) >= 250000
),
payments AS (
    SELECT t.bank, t.account, t.amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN qualifying_accounts q ON q.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date <  DATE '1999-01-01'
),
totals AS (
    SELECT bank,
           account,
           COUNT(*)    AS num_payments,
           SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payments
    GROUP BY bank, account
)
SELECT bank,
       account,
       num_payments,
       total_amount
FROM totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM totals)
ORDER BY bank, account

WITH prachatice AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM district
  WHERE a2 = 'Prachatice'
),
borrowers AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
  FROM account a
  JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM prachatice)
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date
),
counterparties AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS outside_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account <> 0
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
owners AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.district_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
base AS (
  SELECT b.account_id,
         b.date,
         b.total_borrowed,
         COALESCE(cp.outside_counterparties, 0) AS outside_counterparties,
         o.district_id AS home_district_id,
         di.a4::bigint AS district_population
  FROM borrowers b
  JOIN owners o ON o.account_id = b.account_id
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = o.district_id
  LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       date,
       total_borrowed,
       outside_counterparties,
       home_district_id,
       district_population,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC

WITH holder_districts AS (
  SELECT c.type AS card_type,
         d.district_id,
         CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) AS inhabitants
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp dp ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
  JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
min_per_type AS (
  SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
  FROM holder_districts
  GROUP BY card_type
)
SELECT DISTINCT h.card_type, h.district_id, h.inhabitants
FROM holder_districts h
JOIN min_per_type m
  ON h.card_type = m.card_type
 AND h.inhabitants = m.min_inhabitants
ORDER BY h.card_type, h.district_id

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card cd WHERE cd.disp_id = d.disp_id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = d.account_id)
),
q AS (
  SELECT di.a3 AS region,
         di.a2 AS dname,
         di.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
         di.a11,
         di.a13
  FROM qualifying qc
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = qc.district_id
)
SELECT q.region,
       ROUND(AVG(q.a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
       ROUND(AVG(q.a13)::numeric, 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
       (SELECT q2.dname
        FROM q q2
        WHERE q2.region = q.region
        ORDER BY q2.inhabitants DESC, q2.dname ASC
        LIMIT 1) AS most_populous_district
FROM q
GROUP BY q.region

WITH top3 AS (
  SELECT
    a2 AS district_name,
    a16 AS crimes_1996,
    a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
    translate(a2,
      'áéíóúůýčďěňřšťžÁÉÍÓÚŮÝČĎĚŇŘŠŤŽ',
      'aeiouuycdenrstzAEIOUUYCDENRSTZ') AS name_key
  FROM district
  WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia'
  ORDER BY a4::bigint DESC, name_key ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
top3_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(crimes_1996::numeric) AS avg3
  FROM top3
),
all_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(a16::numeric) AS avg_all
  FROM district
)
SELECT
  t.district_name,
  t.crimes_1996,
  ROUND(ta.avg3, 2) AS three_district_avg_1996,
  ROUND(aa.avg_all, 2) AS overall_avg_1996,
  ROUND(ta.avg3 - aa.avg_all, 2) AS difference
FROM top3 t
CROSS JOIN top3_avg ta
CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
ORDER BY t.inhabitants DESC, t.name_key ASC

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         cl.gender,
         dist.district_id,
         dist.a2,
         CAST(dist.a4 AS bigint) AS inhabitants,
         dist.a10,
         dist.a11
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d     ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client cl  ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a  ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    AND CAST(dist.a4 AS bigint) > 100000
    AND d.account_id IN (
          SELECT t.account_id
          FROM trans t
          GROUP BY t.account_id
          HAVING AVG(t.balance) > 1000
        )
),
stats AS (
  SELECT gender,
         COUNT(*) AS district_count,
         ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
         ROUND(AVG(a10)::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY gender
),
top AS (
  SELECT q.gender, q.a2, q.inhabitants,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY q.gender ORDER BY q.inhabitants DESC) AS rk
  FROM qualifying q
)
SELECT t.gender,
       s.district_count,
       t.a2 AS district_name,
       t.inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM top t
JOIN stats s ON s.gender = t.gender
WHERE t.rk = 1
ORDER BY t.gender DESC

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount, a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24

),
loan_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.a4, d.a11
    FROM top_loans t
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
)
SELECT
    ld.district_id,
    CAST(ld.a4 AS bigint) AS inhabitants,
    ROUND((SELECT AVG(a11) FROM loan_districts)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary
FROM loan_districts ld
ORDER BY CAST(ld.a4 AS bigint) DESC, ld.district_id ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.district_id,

WITH region AS (

  WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'
),
region_districts AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a2
  FROM district d
  JOIN region r ON d.a3 = r.a3
),
acc96 AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN region_districts rd ON rd.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
    AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
last_tx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.account_id)
         t.account_id, t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN acc96 x ON x.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
),
acc_bal AS (
  SELECT x.account_id, x.district_id, lt.balance
  FROM acc96 x
  LEFT JOIN last_tx lt ON lt.account_id = x.account_id
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT rd.a2 AS district_name,
         COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
         AVG(ab.balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM acc_bal ab
  JOIN region_districts rd ON rd.district_id = ab.district_id
  GROUP BY rd.a2
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(balance) AS region_avg
  FROM acc_bal
),
top_district AS (
  SELECT district_name
  FROM district_stats
  ORDER BY avg_balance DESC NULLS LAST, district_name ASC

)
SELECT ds.district_name,
       ds.num_accounts,
       ROUND(ds.avg_balance::numeric, 2) AS avg_end_1996_balance,
       ROUND(rs.region_avg::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_end_1996_balance,
       td.district_name AS top_district
FROM district_stats ds
CROSS JOIN region_stats rs
CROSS JOIN top_district td
ORDER BY ds.district_name

WITH w AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
acc AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
so AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS so_total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    d.a4::bigint AS population,
    w.total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::bigint, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ROUND(COALESCE(so.so_total, 0)::numeric / acc.num_accounts, 2) AS avg_standing_order_per_account
  FROM district d
  JOIN w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN so ON so.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
)
SELECT
  district_name,
  region,
  population,
  total_withdrawn,
  withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
  avg_standing_order_per_account
FROM base
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC, district_name

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS lent
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regional_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.district_id,
           TO_CHAR(a.date, 'YYYY') AS open_year,
           COALESCE(lt.lent, 0) AS lent
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
),
district_year AS (
    SELECT open_year,
           district_id,
           COUNT(*) AS acc_count,
           SUM(lent) AS lent_sum,
           SUM(lent)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS lent_per_acc
    FROM regional_accounts
    GROUP BY open_year, district_id
)
SELECT open_year,
       SUM(acc_count) AS account_count,
       SUM(lent_sum) AS total_lent,
       ROUND(AVG(lent_per_acc), 2) AS avg_lent_per_account_across_districts
FROM district_year
GROUP BY open_year
ORDER BY open_year

SELECT
    t.bank,

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        cd.type AS card_type,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cd.issued)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date)::int) AS age_at_issue,
        dp.account_id,
        c.district_id
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp dp   ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    JOIN client c  ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cd.issued) = 1994
),
loan_agg AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*)    AS loan_count,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    b.client_id,
    b.gender,
    b.birth_date,
    b.card_type,
    b.age_at_issue,
    COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0)    AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(la.total_amount, 0)  AS total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) >= 1 AND b.age_at_issue < 30  THEN 'Young borrower'
        WHEN COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) >= 1 AND b.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
        ELSE 'Non-borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    d.a2  AS district_name,
    d.a11 AS district_avg_salary,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.gender ORDER BY b.age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON la.account_id = b.account_id
JOIN district d       ON d.district_id = b.district_id
ORDER BY b.client_id

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.date, a.frequency, a.district_id
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE dp.client_id = 3541
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS tx_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS total_income,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS total_expense
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_accounts ca ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
district_ranked AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a11,
           d.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY d.a4::bigint DESC) AS pop_rank
    FROM district d
),
region_top AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3,
           a2 AS top_district_name,
           inhabitants AS top_inhabitants
    FROM district_ranked
    ORDER BY a3, inhabitants DESC, district_id
),
region_clients AS (
    SELECT d.a3, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.a3
)
SELECT ca.account_id,
       ca.date AS account_opened,
       ca.frequency,
       dr.a2 AS district_name,
       dr.a3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN ca.district_id = (SELECT c.district_id FROM client c WHERE c.client_id = 3541)
            THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       dr.a11 AS avg_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(ta.tx_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(rc.client_count, 0) AS region_client_count,
       rt.top_district_name,
       rt.top_inhabitants,
       dr.pop_rank
FROM client_accounts ca
JOIN district_ranked dr ON dr.district_id = ca.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = ca.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg ta ON ta.account_id = ca.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_clients rc ON rc.a3 = dr.a3
LEFT JOIN region_top rt ON rt.a3 = dr.a3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ca.account_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'

      AND CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) >= 100000
),
qualifying_districts AS (

    JOIN qualifying_accounts q ON q.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT

WITH qual_accounts AS (

  FROM account a
  JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.duration > 24
    AND a.date < DATE '1997-01-01'
),
qual_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM qual_accounts
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT d.a3 AS region,

         SUM(d.a4::bigint) AS total_population
  FROM district d
  JOIN qual_districts qd ON qd.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.a3
),
region_accounts AS (

  FROM qual_accounts qa

)
SELECT rs.region,

JOIN region_accounts ra ON ra.region = rs.region

WHERE d.district_id IN (

    FROM client c

)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2) AS average_salary
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
INNER JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
trans_totals AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ'  THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans t
    JOIN gold_accounts g ON t.account_id = g.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan l
    JOIN gold_accounts g ON l.account_id = g.account_id
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
external_counts AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || '|' || t.account::text) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    JOIN gold_accounts g ON t.account_id = g.account_id
    WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> ''
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL AND t.account <> 0
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       d.a2 AS district_name,
       d.a3 AS region,
       COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0)  AS total_received,
       COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
       COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0)      AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(ec.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ec.external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM gold_accounts g
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id = g.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_totals tt   ON tt.account_id = g.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc    ON lc.account_id = g.account_id
LEFT JOIN external_counts ec ON ec.account_id = g.account_id
ORDER BY rank, a.account_id

WITH female_loans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.account_id,
    l.amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments,
    l.status,
    c.client_id,
    c.birth_date,
    a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT
    fl.*,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fl.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
  FROM female_loans fl
),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_loans WHERE amount_rank <= 3
),
account_trans AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM top_loans)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT
  tl.client_id,
  tl.amount AS loan_amount,
  tl.duration AS duration_months,
  ROUND((tl.payments::numeric * tl.duration), 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((tl.payments::numeric * tl.duration - tl.amount), 2) AS interest_paid,
  tl.status AS loan_status,
  di.a2 AS district,
  di.a3 AS region,
  COALESCE(at.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * tl.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0) > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'
  END AS income_category,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM loan l2
    JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
    JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = a2.district_id
    WHERE d2.a3 = di.a3
  ) AS region_loan_count,
  (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(d3.a11)::numeric, 2)
    FROM district d3
    WHERE d3.a3 = di.a3
  ) AS region_avg_salary,
  DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', tl.birth_date))::int AS client_age
FROM top_loans tl
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = tl.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_trans at ON at.account_id = tl.account_id
ORDER BY tl.amount DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount < 100000
  AND l.status = 'C'

WITH cohort_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN c.birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young'
            WHEN c.birth_date <  DATE '1920-01-01' THEN 'old'
        END AS cohort,
        a.district_id

WITH driver AS (

speed_853 AS (

speed_854 AS (

WITH classic_owner_accounts AS (

),
client_counts AS (

           COUNT(DISTINCT coa.client_id) AS num_clients

),
payment_stats AS (

           SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM account a

    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM classic_owner_accounts)
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT di.a2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(cc.num_clients, 0) AS num_clients,
       COALESCE(ps.num_external_accounts, 0) AS num_external_accounts,
       COALESCE(ps.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district di
LEFT JOIN client_counts cc ON cc.district_id = di.district_id
LEFT JOIN payment_stats ps ON ps.district_id = di.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC

WITH winners AS (

  FROM results

  GROUP BY driverid
  ORDER BY wins DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
maxpts AS (
  SELECT ds.driverid, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points

)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, m.max_points

WITH tabor_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor'
),
owners AS (
    SELECT di.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp di
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = di.client_id
    WHERE di.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards_96 AS (
    SELECT di.account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp di ON di.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY di.account_id
),
loans_96 AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           BOOL_OR(l.status = 'B') AS has_default,
           BOOL_OR(l.status IN ('C', 'D')) AS has_running
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
trans_97 AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_trans,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN t.amount END), 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(MAX(t.balance), 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT ta.account_id,
       ta.opened_date,
       o.gender,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS owner_age,
       COALESCE(c96.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
       COALESCE(l96.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(l96.num_loans, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
           WHEN l96.has_default THEN 'defaulted'
           WHEN l96.has_running THEN 'repaying'
           ELSE 'paid off'
       END AS loan_standing,
       COALESCE(t97.num_trans, 0) AS num_trans_1997,
       COALESCE(t97.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
       COALESCE(t97.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
       COALESCE(t97.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t97.peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM tabor_accounts ta
LEFT JOIN owners o ON o.account_id = ta.account_id
LEFT JOIN cards_96 c96 ON c96.account_id = ta.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_96 l96 ON l96.account_id = ta.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_97 t97 ON t97.account_id = ta.account_id
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, ta.account_id

mn AS (SELECT MIN(t) AS t FROM rt),
mx AS (SELECT MAX(t) AS t FROM rt)
SELECT
  (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT rt.circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY rt.circuitref)
     FROM rt WHERE rt.t = (SELECT t FROM mn)) AS earliest_circuitref,

        SELECT array_agg(x ORDER BY x)

            string_to_array(

        ) AS x
    ) = ARRAY['RA', 'SJS']
),
patient_flags AS (

    FROM overlap_patients o

    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal_platelet) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,

FROM patient_flags

)

SELECT p.sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count

GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS patient_count
FROM examination

WITH psa_patients AS (

)
SELECT

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM patient p
  WHERE p.sex = 'F'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination e WHERE e.id = p.id)
),
rnp_results AS (
  SELECT l.id, TRIM(l.rnp) AS rnp_val
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN cohort c ON c.id = l.id
  WHERE l.rnp IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.rnp) <> ''
),
per_patient AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN regexp_replace(rnp_val, '^1:', '') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'

                 WHEN regexp_replace(rnp_val, '^1:', '')::numeric > 64 THEN 1

               END
        ELSE 0
      END

  FROM rnp_results

)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(elevated) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM per_patient

WHERE l.id IN (SELECT e.id FROM examination e)

SELECT p.sex,

SELECT e.symptoms

SELECT ROUND(

WITH first_exam AS (

SELECT ROUND(AVG(fe.first_exam_date - p."First Date")) AS avg_delay_days

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 END)

WITH tcho AS (

group_max AS (

 AND t."T-CHO" = g.max_tcho

WITH rnp_levels AS (

)
SELECT DISTINCT id, rnp_level

WITH abnormal AS (

FROM patient p

WHERE p.sex IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT DISTINCT

WHERE l.ldh > 600

SELECT AVG(hct) AS avg_hematocrit

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS female_patient_count

SELECT

WITH latest_igg AS (

WITH latest AS (

strong AS (

youngest AS (

        FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = p.id
          AND (l.rbc <= 3.5 OR l.rbc >= 6.0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = p.id
          AND CASE
                WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric > 0
                ELSE false
              END
      )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND l.wbc > 3.5
  AND l.wbc < 9.0
  AND (l.fg <= 150 OR l.fg >= 450)
  AND (CASE
         WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(l.rnp AS numeric)
       END) > 15

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.birthday
  FROM patient p
  JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE CASE
          WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN l.rnp::numeric
        END >= 64
),
aged AS (
  SELECT DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', birthday))::int AS age_years
  FROM eligible
  WHERE birthday IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age_years)::numeric, 1) AS avg_age
FROM aged
WHERE age_years < 70

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         1
       ) AS female_percentage
FROM patient p
WHERE p.birthday BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31'
  AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = p.id
          AND l.cpk >= 250
      )

SELECT CAST(COUNT(b.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS avg_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN DATE '1981-01-01' AND DATE '1986-12-31'
  AND date_part('year', age(l.date, p.birthday)) < 50
  AND l.plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND l."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0', '')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(o.cnt, 0))::numeric, 4) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
) m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'o'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
) o ON m.molecule_id = o.molecule_id

WITH element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '-'
    GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element
FROM element_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM element_counts)

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
)

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM atom a
            WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
              AND LOWER(a.element) = 'f'
        )
    ) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT b.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
   FROM atom a
   JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
   JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
   WHERE a.element = 'i' AND b.bond_type = '-') AS iodine_atoms_with_single_bond,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
   FROM atom a
   JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
   JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
   WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '-') AS sulfur_atoms_with_single_bond

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '#'
      )
  AND molecule_id IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE LOWER(element) IN ('p', 'br')
      )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
       m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
       COUNT(b.bond_id) AS multiple_bond_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond b
       ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = '+'

WITH mol_group AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM bond b
                WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
                  AND b.bond_type IS DISTINCT FROM '-'
            )
            THEN 'all_single_bonds'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS grp
    FROM molecule m
)
SELECT
    grp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM mol_group
GROUP BY grp

SELECT b.bond_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'
GROUP BY b.bond_type

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_counts AS (
    SELECT p.element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_cnt
    FROM plus_atoms p
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM connected c
        WHERE c.atom_id = p.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = p.atom_id
    )
    GROUP BY p.element
),
top_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM bonded_counts
    WHERE bonded_cnt = (SELECT MAX(bonded_cnt) FROM bonded_counts)
)
SELECT t.element,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plus_atoms p2 WHERE p2.element = t.element)
             / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plus_atoms), 2) AS percentage
FROM top_elements t

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.partner_atom_id) AS chlorine_bonded_atom_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS partner_atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id AS partner_atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
) t

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id2) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND m.label = '+'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM (
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS neighbor_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id AS neighbor_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
) AS bonded

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
 AND m.label = '+'
JOIN connected c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM atom o
  WHERE o.element = a.element
    AND o.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
)

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
  SELECT b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'n'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(bond_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM (
    SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(c.atom_id2) AS bond_count
    FROM atom a
    LEFT JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
    GROUP BY a.atom_id
) AS per_atom

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM bond b
WHERE b.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'y'
)
AND b.bond_id IN (
    SELECT c.bond_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE LOWER(a1.element) = 'h' OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'h'
)

WITH element_mol_counts AS (
    SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS n_mol
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
),
rare_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id, a.element
    FROM atom a
    JOIN element_mol_counts e ON e.element = a.element
    WHERE e.n_mol = 1
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ra.molecule_id
    FROM rare_atoms ra
    JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = ra.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
rare_bonds AS (
    SELECT ra.molecule_id, c.bond_id
    FROM rare_atoms ra
    JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = ra.atom_id
    UNION
    SELECT ra.molecule_id, c.bond_id
    FROM rare_atoms ra
    JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id2 = ra.atom_id
)
SELECT q.molecule_id,
       COUNT(rb.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM qualifying q
LEFT JOIN rare_bonds rb ON rb.molecule_id = q.molecule_id
GROUP BY q.molecule_id
ORDER BY q.molecule_id

SELECT a2.element AS element,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  AND a1.element = 'c'
GROUP BY a2.element

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom a
        WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND a.element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND b.bond_type = '-'
      )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT b.bond_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST(a1.element, a2.element), GREATEST(a1.element, a2.element))) AS pair_count
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT bc.bond_type AS bond_kind,
       bc.bond_count,
       pc.pair_count AS element_pair_count,
       m.label
FROM bond_counts bc
JOIN pair_counts pc ON pc.bond_type = bc.bond_type
CROSS JOIN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377') m
ORDER BY bc.bond_count DESC, bc.bond_type ASC

SELECT a.element,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
         WHERE EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM connected c
           WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
         )
       ) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element

WITH carbon_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'c'
),
atom_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS num_carbons,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS num_chlorines
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS num_multiple
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_carbon_bonds
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.bond_id IN (
    SELECT cn.bond_id
    FROM connected cn
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = cn.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'c'
    UNION
    SELECT cn.bond_id
    FROM connected cn
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = cn.atom_id2
    WHERE a.element = 'c'
  )
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
inventory AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         m.label,
         ac.num_atoms,
         COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
         ac.num_carbons,
         ac.num_chlorines,
         COALESCE(cb.num_carbon_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_bonds,
         COALESCE(bc.num_multiple, 0) AS num_multiple
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN carbon_molecules cm ON cm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN carbon_bonds cb ON cb.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (
         ORDER BY num_carbon_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
       ) AS rank,
       molecule_id,
       label,
       num_atoms,
       num_bonds,
       num_carbons,
       num_chlorines,
       num_carbon_bonds,
       num_multiple
FROM inventory
ORDER BY rank, molecule_id

WITH ends AS (
    SELECT atom_id AS aid, bond_id FROM connected
    UNION ALL
    SELECT atom_id2 AS aid, bond_id FROM connected
)
SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ends e
        WHERE e.aid = a.atom_id
    )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM ends e
        JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = e.bond_id
        WHERE e.aid = a.atom_id
          AND b.bond_type <> '-'
    )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element

WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  UNION
  SELECT c.atom_id2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
),
triple_elements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element
  FROM triple_bond_atoms t
  JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = t.atom_id
)
SELECT a.element,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom a
JOIN triple_elements te ON te.element = a.element
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC
